rules.statement: The court has the discretion to refuse a certificate of discharge for an insolvent who has committed specific offenses under section 151 of the Insolvency Act, even if not all elements are strictly met.
rules.supporting_quote: "So far as these latter charges are concerned under section 124, charges 6 (a), 6 (b) ,6 (d), and 2 contain the particulars required according to the ruling in the case of Marikar v. Arunachalam Chetty [1 18 N. L. R. 75.]"
